subject: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)
related_links: Linear: PM-414 (pilot plan and rollout gates)
body:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

Jordan — requesting formal approval to run the PLG signal-triggered outbound pilot starting next week.

What we’re asking to do (pilot only):
- Trigger SDR outreach off a small set of high-signal events (v1):
  1) sustained spend growth (30d + acceleration) AND/OR repeated 429/rate-limit hits
  2) “security intent” (SOC2/SSO/audit logs/docs engagement) AND “contact sales” click
  3) residency/region constraint event (EU region selection attempts + docs)
- Route into HubSpot: create a Company timeline event + create a Task for assigned owner + enroll in the relevant sequence.
- Slack notification only for “security intent + contact sales” (high intent), to #sales (David can confirm channel integration).

Guardrails (proposed):
- No user-level identifiers in the outbound context (no emails/names from product telemetry). Outreach is based on company domain/account only.
- Suppression rules:
  - Active opportunity or already in an open sales sequence
  - Existing enterprise accounts owned by CS (Jasmine to confirm list)
  - Explicit opt-out / unsubscribed
  - Cooldown: 30 days per company per signal category
- Messaging:
  - Must be framed as “we noticed you may be hitting scale limits” / “happy to share best practices” vs. “we saw your exact usage.”
  - Include opt-out language in email #1.

Pilot size + timing:
- ~35 companies (list drafted; includes NA + EMEA mix)
- 2-week run, with weekly review on false positives + complaints + meeting conversion

Attachments:
- PLG_Signal_Pilot_Outreach_Guardrails_v3 (Google Doc)
- SDR_Sequences_PLG_Signals_Draft_A-B (Google Doc)

If you approve, I’ll coordinate kickoff with Sales Ops + CS + Security, and we’ll lock the final copy by EOD Tue.

Thanks,
Grace O’Connor
SDR Program Owner
Redwood Inference


---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 9:38 AM PST
Subject: Re: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

Approved to proceed as a pilot, with the following conditions:

1) Keep the trigger set tight (as listed) and make any additions a separate approval.
2) Copy must NOT imply we have visibility into individual user actions. Keep it “account-level signals / patterns.”
3) Suppress aggressively (active opps, CS-owned enterprise, opt-out, and the 30-day cooldown).
4) If we receive any complaint that indicates discomfort with how we’re using signals, we pause outreach immediately and review.

Aisha/Michael — please respond in-thread with any required language changes, especially on opt-out.
David/Isabelle — confirm HubSpot workflow + unsubscribe handling is correct before anything sends.

Grace — once everyone confirms, send me the final pilot cohort + owners and the exact sequences that will go live.

Jordan Blake
CRO
Redwood Inference


---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:11 AM PST
Subject: Re: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

Security OK with the pilot under these requirements:

- Data minimization: outbound context should only contain (a) company name/domain, (b) high-level signal category (e.g., “rate limiting / throughput constraints” or “security review intent”), and (c) timestamp window (week/month) at most.
- No raw telemetry artifacts in CRM notes (no request IDs, no IPs, no user IDs, no endpoint paths that could reveal customer data).
- Visibility: restrict the internal “signal detail” fields in HubSpot to sales leadership + sales ops + assigned owner (as feasible). At minimum, do not post sensitive details into Slack.
- For security intent: only reference that we can provide security materials / help answer questionnaires. Do not say “we saw you reading SOC2/SSO docs.”

If any of these constraints are hard to implement in HubSpot workflows, please flag before sending.

Dr. Aisha Rahman
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

Legal is fine with this pilot as described.

Two edits/requirements for the outreach templates:

1) Opt-out language: Ensure email #1 includes a clear opt-out line. Recommend:
   “If you’d prefer not to receive these messages, reply ‘opt out’ and we’ll stop.”
   (And make sure Sales Ops has a process to honor it.)

2) Avoid statements that could be interpreted as monitoring a specific person’s behavior. Phrases to avoid:
   - “We noticed you visited…”
   - “We saw your team click…”
   - “We observed your users…”

Replace with:
   - “Teams at your stage often run into…”
   - “If you’re seeing X, we can help…”

If you plan to include any automated SMS/phone component, that’s out of scope for this approval—bring it back separately.

Michael Grant
Legal Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

+1 from CS with a couple of practical suppression/handoff notes:

- Suppress any account with an assigned CSM in the “Enterprise” segment (Rachel and I can provide the current list today). For those, the signal should create a CS task instead of SDR sequence enrollment.
- Suppress any account that has an open Sev-2/Sev-1 support escalation in the last 14 days (avoid piling on while they’re upset). If that’s too hard technically for pilot, we can do it manually for the 35-company cohort.
- For “rate-limit pain” triggers, the first touch should offer an SE office hours slot (not a hard sell). We’ve had better outcomes when the first interaction is help-oriented.

Grace — once you share the cohort list, I’ll mark which ones should route to CS vs SDR.

Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference


---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Osei <chris_osei@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle_laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 12:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Approval: PLG signal pilot outreach (scope + guardrails + opt-out language)

Thanks all — we’re aligned.

Grace, proceed with pilot setup with these final requirements:
- Adopt Aisha + Michael language guidance verbatim (no “we saw you” phrasing).
- Include opt-out line in email #1 and confirm the operational handling in HubSpot.
- Jasmine’s CS suppression routing is mandatory for enterprise-CS-owned accounts.
- Kill switch: if we see complaints or any sign we’re crossing a line, we pause immediately.

Next steps (by Tue EOD):
1) Grace/Isabelle/David: confirm HubSpot workflow config + unsubscribe/opt-out handling.
2) Grace/Jasmine: finalize the 35-company cohort + owner mapping + suppression flags.
3) Nikhil/Chris: confirm the v1 trigger list for pilot (no additions midstream).
4) Send me the final sequences that will go live (one doc link is fine).

We’ll review outcomes weekly: signal volume, meeting rate, false positives, and any negative feedback.

Jordan
